description: Frontend: replace ResultsPage.jsx and ResultDetailPage.jsx placeholders; add named exports listResults/getResult to testsApi.js; add client test ResultDetailPage.test.jsx. App.jsx routes already exist — do NOT add duplicates.
steps: 1. Add named exports to client/src/api/testsApi.js — add: export const listResults = () => apiClient.get('/results'); and export const getResult = (id) => apiClient.get(`/results/${id}`); — also add them to the testsApi default export object as listResults and getResult. The object already has getResults and getResultById as stubs — replace those stubs with the real implementations by pointing them to the new named functions. DO NOT add a second submitTest or duplicate any existing export.

2. Replace client/src/pages/ResultsPage.jsx entirely. Implement with: (a) useEffect to call listResults() on mount; (b) three-state handling: loading → <Loader />, error → <Alert type='error' message={error} />, empty → <EmptyState icon='📋' title='No results yet' message='Complete an aptitude test to see your scores here.' action={<Link to='/tests'>Browse Tests</Link>} />; (c) data state → render a <table> with columns: Test, Score, Percentage, Date, and a 'View' <Link> to /results/:resultId. Sort newest-first (API already returns this). Use scope='col' on th elements, scope='row' on first td, for accessibility. Format date as locale string. Show percentage with '%' suffix.

3. Replace client/src/pages/ResultDetailPage.jsx entirely. Implement with: (a) const { id } = useParams(); (b) useEffect to call getResult(id); (c) three-state: Loader, Alert error, and 404 handled by showing 'Result not found' alert; (d) data state: render a heading with large percentage (e.g. '{data.percentage}%'), score/total line, formatted submittedAt date, a category scores table (columns: Category, Score, Total, Accuracy bar), a CSS bar as a
inside a container div, and two action buttons: Retake Test and View Analysis.

4. Create client/src/pages/ResultDetailPage.test.jsx. Mock '../api/testsApi' at the module level (vi.mock) with getResult as a vi.fn(). Write two describe blocks: (a) 'renders score and category rows' — mock getResult to resolve with a fixture result object containing categoryScores, render ResultDetailPage inside MemoryRouter, waitFor the score text to appear, assert the percentage heading, score/total text, and one category row renders; (b) 'shows error alert when API fails' — mock getResult to reject, assert the Alert renders with the error message.
acceptance_criteria: client/src/api/testsApi.js exports listResults and getResult as named exports and in the default object, without duplicating submitTest.
ResultsPage shows Loader while fetching, Alert on error, EmptyState with link to /tests when empty, and a table of results with View links to /results/:id when data is present.
ResultDetailPage shows the percentage prominently, score/total, date, category scores table with CSS bars, Retake Test link to /tests/:testId/attempt, and View Analysis link to /analysis.
App.jsx is NOT modified — routes /results and /results/:id already exist.
npm --prefix client test passes, including ResultDetailPage.test.jsx.
npm --prefix client run build completes with no errors.
